title: A material-specific pot condition can block empty-container recovery
claim: A pot maintenance order required five mudstone boulders while only four free visible mudstone boulders remained. Brewing canceled for lack of empty food-storage items. Reducing that input gate was followed by active pot jobs and resumed brewing.
reproduction: Compare an empty-container cancellation with the actual container order, its exact stone material and every condition. Verify material access and finished containers after a bounded interval; avoid adding a duplicate brew order when the blocker is its storage input.
evidence: Firsthand AI-assisted Namemerchants observations on 2026-11-02; sanitized summaries of native state, not a published save or raw telemetry.
The MakeTool pot order's mudstone threshold was reduced from five to one.
Mudstone was consumed by subsequent pot jobs and brewing resumed; drink stocks later recovered.
limitations: One live fortress on Windows; relevant mods were not fully inventoried. Community reproduction is pending. This does not prove all visible mudstone was initially accessible, nor that the same gate caused every cancellation. The remaining mudstone was eventually exhausted, requiring a later supply or material review.
